appDescription: An in-car AI companion named Daltokki, a moon rabbit character, that watches for signs of driver drowsiness and helps the driver stay alert and take timely rest breaks.

function.name: START_WORD_GAME
function.description: Starts a short Korean word chain game with Daltokki to help the driver stay alert while driving.

function.name: REPORT_DROWSINESS
function.description: Tells Daltokki that the driver feels sleepy so that Daltokki raises the drowsiness level and guides the driver to the nearest rest area.

function.name: ADD_REST_STOP
function.description: Finds the nearest highway rest area or drowsy driver shelter ahead in the current direction and adds it as a navigation waypoint.
